purpose: Test whether bounded LLM cognition adds stable out-of-sample value over frozen B and C without allowing memorized 2021 Moroccan results to identify parties or constituencies.
model_revisions: Resolve and record immutable Hugging Face commit SHA at execution time before holdout unseal.
leakage_controls: No 2021 holdout outcome may exist in the Stage-2a process input.
Constituency names are replaced by opaque district ids.
Party labels are independently permuted to opaque labels within each holdout constituency.
Region names are replaced by opaque group ids.
Only 2016 inputs, frozen B/C predictions, and a deterministic development-example set are supplied.

gates.out_of_sample_improvement: aggregated D frozen score must be strictly lower than both B and C

decision: RETAIN_D only if every blocking gate passes; otherwise KILL_D_FOR_CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE
